expert_error_diversity.interpretation: The dynamic oracle is an unattainable upper bound that may choose a different expert at every gold-prefix token. Pairwise correctness statistics are associations, not causal specialization controls.

limitations: DEV results select calibration and confirmatory candidates; they are not TEST confirmation.
Tokens within an example are correlated; point estimates are reported for committee exploration.
All-token example accuracy under teacher forcing is not free-running exact-match accuracy.
Soft/logit decisions are exact only where the top-k union certificate passes.
